changes.evidence: After his WWI discharge Ben runs his own detective firm, B. Reilly Investigations, with Janet Ruiz as his secretary (Spider-Noir episode 1 onward); only in episode 8 does he make Janet a full partner. The record has him still in the U.S. Army until the very end.

Through the series Janet is secretary at Ben's firm B. Reilly Investigations (episode 1; episode 2 she nearly quits over unpaid wages); Ben makes her a full partner, Reilly and Ruiz, only in episode 8. Reilly and Ruiz does not exist from the start.

In episode 10 (If This Be My Destiny...), after the Project Monolith disaster, Peter leaves his Oscorp internship ('So, I guess your internship is over'), and Harry founds the Worldwide Engineering Brigade (W.E.B.) for the former Oscorp interns; both Marvel Database and the MCU wiki list Peter as a W.E.B. member.
